newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tsann Kuen '96 net hits 46.5 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Tsann Kuen '96 net hits 46.5 mln yuan.

text.p: Earnings per share 0.24 yuan vs n/a
Net assets per share 2.37 yuan vs n/a
Company name: Tsann Kuen (China) Enterprise Co Ltd.
Note: The 1996 figures were released by Shenzhen Stock Exchange and by a company official.

The results were based on Chinese accounting standards, and no earnings per share or net asset figures for 1995 were available, a Tsann Kuen official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
Under international accounting standards, Tsann Kuen booked net profit of 44.55 million yuan for 1996, the official said.
Tsann Kuen had after-tax profit of 38.39 million yuan in 1995 under international standards, according to the appliance maker's 1995 annual report.
The company proposed to distribute a cash dividend of 0.50 yuan and one bonus share to every 10 shares based on 1996 profit, and an one-for-10 bonus issue based on capital surplus, the exchange said.
Trading in Tsann Kuen's B shares will be suspended on Thursday morning and resume in the afternoon, it said.
